# App and widget version synchronization (2026-01-08 16:57Z)

_**User**_

right now there are two parts that build with their own version and build number. The miataru App and the miataruWidgets.

Right now I have to manually change the version and build number on both of them to match. Can there be something done so the Widget Version+Build Number uses the Main App Build Number and Version?

---

Got it. I’ll make the widget target **inherit the same marketing version + build number** as the main app by centralizing them (project-level or shared `.xcconfig`) and ensuring both Info.plists use `$(MARKETING_VERSION)` / `$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)` instead of hardcoded values. Next I’ll inspect your current `Info.plist` files + Xcode build settings and then apply the minimal change.

### What I changed

I updated `miataru.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` so **`MARKETING_VERSION` and `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` are defined once at the project level**, and **removed those settings from the `miataru` (app) target and `miataruWidgets` target**.

Result: **the widget now always inherits the same Version + Build as the main app**, without you having to update both targets.

### Where to update it going forward (one place)

In Xcode, select the **project** (blue icon) → **Build Settings** → set:

- **Marketing Version** (`MARKETING_VERSION`)
- **Current Project Version** (`CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`)

Those values will apply to both **miataru** and **miataruWidgets** automatically (the widget’s `Info.plist` already uses `$(MARKETING_VERSION)` / `$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)`).
